item.title: Online certificates
item.description:
Always curious and eager to grow, I took online courses to level up my coding skills and dive deeper into machine learning and AI. These courses weren’t just about theory—I got hands-on experience, explored real-world applications, and kept pushing my limits. 🚀

Thanks to the Supervised Machine Learning: Regression and Classification course, I gained a solid understanding of the key parameters in regression models and the significance of functions like the sigmoid and logistic functions in various applications. While I wished for a more math-heavy approach, I was ultimately satisfied—walking away with both the theoretical insights and the mathematical foundations behind these models.🚀

item.title: Prepare your data with PreproX: Smart Data Preparation
item.description:
🌐 Welcome to PreproX!

In an effort to optimize my time during busy university days, I developed this web app as a time-saving solution for my machine learning projects. It streamlines the data preprocessing phase by providing an intuitive and user-friendly interface, allowing users to select the necessary transformations effortlessly. The final output is a clean, well-structured dataset, ready for machine learning models.

item.title: SmartLoan: Predict your Loan Approval Likelihood
item.description:
Welcome to SmartLoan, a project designed to predict loan approval outcomes using advanced machine learning techniques.

Developed as part of the Assistance Systems course in the third semester of the Bachelor of Artificial Intelligence program, this project aims to simulate a real-world financial assistance system that assesses loan applications based on a variety of personal and financial attributes.

With the growing demand for automated decision-making in the banking sector, the need for predictive models that can accurately assess loan risk has never been higher. SmartLoan leverages a combination of regression algorithms to estimate the likelihood of a loan being approved, based on factors such as income, credit score, and asset value.
